paragraphs: From Ballina Test Centre depart and take the 1st right onto Primrose Hill.
Continue for about 400 metres then turn left onto Raheen Row.
Drive straight ahead onto Kevin Barry Street, which becomes Teeling Street, Pound Street and then Killala Road.
Stay on Killala Road for about 700 metres then take the next right onto Bohernasup.
Turn right again onto Libadoré.
At the end of the road turn right, staying on Libadoré.
Complete a turnabout in a safe spot as instructed by the examiner.
Head back along Libadoré, keeping left where the road continues.
At the end of the road turn right back onto Bohernasup.
Take the next right off Bohernasup then turn left onto Humbert Street.
At the end of the road turn left onto Pearse Street.
Bear slight right as it becomes Dillon Terrace.
Turn left onto the Sligo Road.
After about 800 metres turn left into Riverslade.
Turn right onto Bóthar na gCúige then right into Riverside Grove.
Inside Riverside Grove keep left, then right as the estate road curves.
At the end of the road turn right back onto Bóthar na gCúige.
Follow Bóthar na gCúige for about 450 metres then turn right and take the next left onto Bunree Road.
Pull in on the left on Bunree Road for a brief stop as directed by the examiner.
Move off from the left on Bunree Road.
At the end of the road turn right onto Bunnyconnellan Road.
Continue straight as it becomes Abbey Street and then Barret Street.
Take the next right onto Water Lane.
Turn left onto James Connolly Street then left onto Station Road.
Turn right onto Primrose Hill heading back towards the Ballina Test Centre.
Complete a short loop around Lord Edward Street, Saint Enda's Villas and Saint Muredach's Terrace.
Arrive on the left at McDermott Street, close to the test centre.
Drive smoothly, use your mirrors early and signal in good time as you return.
